data.title: Oria
data.about:
Elevate your living experience with the dawn of each day, gazing upon Dubai's breathtaking skyline from the luxurious Emaar Oria Apartments, nestled beside the vibrant Creek Beach. Oria by Emaar is not just a residence; it's a lifestyle statement that seamlessly integrates the tranquility of waterfront living with Dubai's dynamic city vibe.

Oria Emaar Dubai offers a selection of 1 to 3 Bedroom Apartments with timeless elegance and modern designs. At Emaar Oria Raw, authentic materials are fused to reinterpret Dubai’s architectural tale, bridging its rich legacy with future sustainable urban designs.

Stroll along the picturesque waterfront promenade, engage in joyful activities in the play areas and adventure playground, or embark on an exhilarating journey along the cycling track and skate park. The sports courts are ready for your game, while direct access to the RTA ferry terminal and metro station ensures you're always connected.

The interiors at Oria Apartments reflect Emaar's signature elegance and attention to detail, with modern designs, high-end finishes, and state-of-the-art facilities. The kitchens, equipped with premium appliances, cater to the refined tastes of those who love to cook and entertain in style.

Experience the ultimate in luxury living at Emaar Oria in Dubai Creek Harbour, a coveted beachfront locale. This prestigious Emaar development offers unmatched views of Dubai's skyline, the iconic coastline, and the historic creek, encapsulating Dubai's vibrant spirit and the serene allure of waterfront living.

  • Comprehensive Fitness at Oria by Emaar: Motivate yourself with our advanced indoor and outdoor gym facilities.
  • Entertainment Hubs within Oria Apartments: Find leisure and relaxation in our modern lounges and game rooms.
  • Innovative Parking at Emaar Oria Dubai Creek Harbour: Enjoy luxury and functionality with our stylish parking solutions.

location_tile.title: Unmatched Accessibility at Oria Emaar Dubai.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Located in Creek Island within Dubai Creek Harbour, where Oria apartments offers upscale living with stunning views and unparalleled amenities. Steps away, Creek Marina presents a world of retail, dining, and artistic flair, all against the breathtaking backdrop of Downtown Dubai. The Harbour Promenade buzzes with life, offering unique vistas of the cityscape, while Creek Side Park presents a verdant retreat, complete with fitness centres and an amphitheatre. 

Central Park invites families with its wide array of activities, and the Viewing Point, soaring at 70 meters, offers unmatched perspectives of Downtown and the Address Grand towers. Oria by Emaar encapsulates the essence of luxury living in a location that’s both convenient and scenic, promising an elevated lifestyle amidst Dubai's dynamic backdrop.

  • 05 Minutes -from Ras al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary
  • 10 Minutes - from Downtown Dubai
  • 15 Minutes - from Dubai Int’l Airport
  • 35 Minutes - from Al Maktoum Int’l Airport
